subject: Converting GGUM parameterization from Roberts et al. (2000) to mirt

messages.subject: Converting GGUM parameterization from Roberts et al. (2000) to mirt
parts:
Hi all, 

This might be a simple question, but the arithmetic is lost on me at the moment. Is anyone aware of how to reparametrize the way Roberts et al. write out the GGUM (see equation 7 here: https://journals.sagepub.com/doi/pdf/10.1177/01466216000241001?casa_token=ehNCgGDG03cAAAAA:u5ko0NmuJkiGGFoG7mu39laPHWf_IGRZAflWAQYZPvzGQ6BgjILoODRlxMpfpoaOQL2QsJyARFff) to the way MIRT estimates it (see pg 114 here: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/mirt/mirt.pdf)

In other words, what's the relationship between the alphas, deltas and taus in Roberts et al. notation and alpha, beta, and psi in the mirt documentation?

Thanks so much in advance

-Ben
